title: 上海高考翻译背诵-73-25一模

items.zh: 此时此刻,每个人的决定都很关键,因为时间已经不多了。
items.en: At the moment, everyone’s decisions are critical because time is running out.

items.zh: 你觉得我们中学生有必要那么关注网红吗?
items.en: Do you think it necessary for middle school students to pay so much attention to influencers?

items.zh: 请记住:面对困难和挑战,恒心和耐心可以帮助我们攻坚克难,走向成功。
items.en: Please keep in mind: in the face of hardships and challenges, persistence and patience can overcome obstacles and achieve success.

items.zh: 他这几天在网上老是收到陌生人的红包。幸亏他没打开,才没有上当受骗实际上都是陷阱啊!
items.en: These days, he kept receiving red packets from stranger online. Luckily, he didn’t click them, so he avoided being fooled. They were actually traps.
